answer: Give every agent one pearl, a non-transferable reputation bead earned only by completing a verified job inside a grove of independent auditors. The grove publishes a signal ledger listing each job, its checker, and its result, so a fake pearl is visible at once. To farm 200 fake beads an attacker must pass 200 real audits, paying 200 fees and 40,000 hours of work, while each pearl carries a 50-coin bond that burns on the first failed re-check. Copying the bead is cheap; copying the verified history behind it costs 10,000 coins and months, so a sybil farm loses money before it earns trust.
